reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the low-dimensional constraint by focusing on nanoscale strain and compositional gradients, proposes a physically sound mechanism for hysteresis and magnetocaloric response in this regime, and provides a clear, testable intervention with a well-defined falsification experiment. Hypothesis B relies on grain size optimization and cites evidence from bulk or unrelated systems, without adequately justifying why this mechanism would dominate in genuinely low-dimensional FeMnNiGeSi films.
